EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 1
EPISODE LOGLINE: Junior auditor Nadia Okonjo exposes a pension theft at the company gala, and the CFO frames her for it.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Opening episode.

--- SCRIPT START ---

SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. MERIDIAN CREST TOWER – GALA BALLROOM – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 01:01.32

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.40)
Wide shot of a glittering corporate gala; a banner reads MERIDIAN CREST: TWENTY YEARS OF TRUST.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.40)
Nadia, in a borrowed black dress, pushes through the crowd clutching a printed spreadsheet.

**NADIA (Urgent, Low):**
Start: (00:04.70) | End: (00:10.26)
"Mr. Voss, four million dollars left the pension fund last night. I traced it."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:10.66) | End: (00:13.06)
Close-up on Grant Voss, his smile freezing.

**GRANT (Smooth, Cold):**
Start: (00:10.66) | End: (00:14.52)
"Not here, Miss Okonjo. Smile. The board is watching."

**NADIA (Defiant):**
Start: (00:14.92) | End: (00:19.80)
"Then let them watch. The transfer has your approval code on it."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:20.20) | End: (00:24.60)
Grant grabs the spreadsheet from her hand and raises it high above his head.

**GRANT (Shouting):**
Start: (00:24.90) | End: (00:29.44)
"Everyone! Our junior auditor has been stealing from the pension fund!"

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:29.84) | End: (00:31.84)
The music cuts out. A glass shatters on the marble floor.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:29.84) | End: (00:32.24)
Slow push-in on Nadia as two hundred faces turn toward her.

**NADIA (Shocked):**
Start: (00:29.84) | End: (00:34.38)
"That's a lie! I found the theft, I didn't commit it!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:34.78) | End: (00:39.78)
Selene March steps out of the crowd in a white gown and slaps Nadia across the face.

**SELENE (Cruel, Mocking):**
Start: (00:40.08) | End: (00:45.30)
"Ten years of friendship, Nadia, and you rob the people who fed you?"

**NADIA (Horrified):**
Start: (00:45.70) | End: (00:50.24)
"Selene... you know me. You know I would never do this."

**GRANT (Commanding):**
Start: (00:50.64) | End: (00:53.82)
"Security! Get her out of my building!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:54.22) | End: (00:59.02)
Two guards seize Nadia's arms and drag her toward the service exit as phones record her.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:59.32) | End: (01:01.32)
Camera shutters click like rain.

SCENE 02
Scene heading: EXT. MERIDIAN CREST TOWER – LOADING DOCK – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:59.32
Scene end: 01:42.30

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:59.32) | End: (01:01.72)
Overhead shot of rain hammering the loading dock.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:59.32) | End: (01:03.92)
The guards shove Nadia onto the wet concrete and slam the steel door behind her.

**NADIA (Broken, Whispering):**
Start: (01:04.22) | End: (01:07.40)
"Twenty years of trust. What a joke."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:07.80) | End: (01:13.20)
A hooded man steps out of the shadows holding an umbrella. It is Theo Kellan, the quiet IT contractor.

**THEO (Calm):**
Start: (01:13.50) | End: (01:18.72)
"You weren't wrong about the four million. It was only the first transfer."

**NADIA (Suspicious):**
Start: (01:19.12) | End: (01:23.32)
"Who are you? Why would the IT guy know that?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:23.72) | End: (01:26.12)
Close-up on a silver USB drive in Theo's palm.

**THEO (Quiet, Urgent):**
Start: (01:23.72) | End: (01:29.28)
"Because I copied his private ledger before he wiped it. There are eleven more."

**NADIA (Desperate):**
Start: (01:29.68) | End: (01:32.52)
"Then give it to the police!"

**THEO (Grim):**
Start: (01:32.92) | End: (01:39.50)
"The police chief was at that gala. Server room, before midnight, or the backups are gone forever."

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:39.90) | End: (01:41.90)

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:39.90) | End: (01:42.30)
